statusSemantics.not_required: The evaluation profile does not require Domain Projection and may proceed without it.
statusSemantics.not_ready: Required Domain facts are incomplete; the consumer returns NR and must not substitute score zero.
statusSemantics.degraded: Required facts are complete while supporting or diagnostic inputs have gaps.
statusSemantics.ready: The consumer may create its own immutable formal Domain input snapshot.
statusSemantics.blocked_drift: A release, schema, definition or mapping contract drift was detected; fail closed.
